reserveReview.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 26505955 (hash 0xa50e54c6703eaed980d65280d5d8eb0d0bda24f104ed8f48d94814aafedd0767, 2026-11-27T10:30:47Z), tMXN totalSupply was 10,013,064.064462747 tMXN (~$512,571 USD at DefiLlama's $0.05119019 quote, or ~$512,278 USD at Chainlink MXN/USD $0.05116097). The deployed tMXN Morpho V2 Vault (0x43e3f5e27422c3a938269368eb7c3a3b545bb6ca, Steakhouse USDC adapter) held totalAssets() = 451,180.52 USDC (an on-chain liability-coverage ratio of ~88.0% of tMXN value), while CollateralManager (0x2a21014b89f72de3ffa6d645f89b8ca5a6effe75) held 0 idle USDC and Controller.ratio() was set to 0.135 (13.5% routed to CustodianModule for off-chain hedging). Separately, at finalized Base block 62923312, Chainlink's Tenbin Aggregated Off-Chain Reserves feed (0x7b1c8c60c05913af3aa21bae3b32a02ab4f39bd3) reported $291,208.36 (updated 2026-11-27T10:06:07Z) across all Tenbin assets combined at Ripple Prime, combining USD cash, USDC, and unrealized futures P&L. Because per-token off-chain asset totals are not segregated across tGLD, tMXN, and tBRL, neither tMXN's total reserves nor its off-chain share is established; whole-book reserve weights are therefore withheld as a single 100% unclassified residual pending per-token reserve totals.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer collateral architecture and pinned Ethereum Morpho V2 Vault totalAssets() at block 26505955 (451,180.52 USDC, ~88.0% liability coverage); whole-book reserve denominator unobserved because off-chain Chainlink PoR is aggregated across products
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Whole-book reserve weights are withheld because Tenbin reports off-chain reserves at Ripple Prime and undisclosed FCM clearing accounts (combining USD cash, USDC, and unrealized CME futures P&L) only as one combined cross-product Chainlink PoR figure ($291,208.36 across tGLD, tMXN, and tBRL). Pinned on-chain Morpho V2 USDC (451,180.52 USDC) equals ~88.0% of tMXN liabilities, not a whole-book reserve weight.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Tenbin's documentation describes BVI segregated-portfolio statutory asset segregation under Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC Ltd. and a bankruptcy-remote structure, but no independent legal opinion is published and the Terms of Use classify each token as an unsecured debt obligation. On-chain USDC is lent via the Steakhouse USDC Morpho V2 vault and off-chain collateral margins CME futures at Ripple Prime and undisclosed FCM partners, so rehypothecation/deployment of collateral is permitted and per-asset off-chain custody shares remain unverified.
